active.name: Mobilize Fast Charge
active.status: Renault/Mobilize confirms deployment into Spain in 2026 and an own ultra-fast network. Official published pricing is launch-window dependent (credit-card launch rate 0.41 EUR/kWh for each station's first two months; Mobilize Charge Pass 0.39 EUR/kWh for one year), so no timeless Spain-wide direct tariff can be integrated without station opening dates or station-specific current pricing. Renault Group is transitioning charging services toward the Plug Inn brand in 2026; keep identity resolution active and do not assume the France rollout timing applies identically to Spain.

Do not count the platform name itself as a physical CPO or propagate one tariff across stations unless a specific station's physical operator is independently identified.

Zunder's official history states that EasyCharger changed its name and image to Zunder in 2022; current legal entity is Grupo Easycharger S.A.
